caption: The drawing depicts a brown ceramic pot with a round, bulbous body, a wide mouth, and two rounded handles positioned symmetrically on either side. The surface of the pot features a yellowish decorative pattern on the front, resembling swirling floral or abstract motifs, painted onto the brown glaze of the pot. The overall shape is gently tapering at the base and the rim is slightly flared outward. The background is plain and light-colored, likely off-white or beige, with no other objects present. A signature in green reading "E.H. Shellady 36" is present towards the lower right of the pot.
title: Pa. German Jar
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
